step_by_step_approach: Select the monthly sales records for products 4160 and 7790.
Restrict the records to the first 36 months beginning in January 2016.
Apply seasonality adjustments to the data for time steps 7 through 30.
Fit a weighted regression model using the adjusted data.
Use the model to forecast sales for each month of 2018.
Sum the monthly forecasts to obtain an annual forecast for each product.
Compute the average of the two products' annual forecast values.
